failing_checks.title: Per-action amount bound
failing_checks.reason: transfer() pushes the caller's amount string into Operation.payment with no maximum before signing. createAccount only has a minimum (startingBalance < 1). pathPay has no amount cap. The only caps are the history page limit (AccountService.ts:95) and the fee ceiling (Stellar.ts:237), so no per-actio

failing_checks.title: Cumulative budget
failing_checks.reason: The only numeric controls are a fee ceiling per submit call and the history page limit. There is no running total of value paid per day, session or caller, and nothing persisted, so many small payments can each pass per-call checks. Value movement is in scope, so this is not not_applicable.

failing_checks.title: Atomic budget accounting
failing_checks.reason: No budget or balance check exists to make atomic, and no spend is recorded before submission. Two concurrent submitWithFeeIncrease calls each pass with no shared state. Concurrent calls on one source account collide only at the sequence number (tx_bad_seq), which prevents double spend only by accide

failing_checks.title: Recipient binding
failing_checks.reason: transfer() takes destinationAddress from its caller with no allowlist or binding to the authenticated user, and transferWithdrawalTransaction takes the destination from the anchor's transaction response (fetched content). failing_checks.title: Asset identity and units
failing_checks.reason: Asset identity is code only in the SEP-24 allowlist, so an issuer-less code passes. Amounts are otherwise passed as strings to the SDK without a 7-decimal or sign check, and transferWithdrawalTransaction pays the anchor's amount_in in the caller-supplied assetId without comparing the anchor's asset.

failing_checks.title: Replay and double payment
failing_checks.reason: build() appends this.operations to the underlying builder on every call, so a second build of the same TransactionBuilder yields a transaction with duplicated payments. failing_checks.title: Slippage and quoted prices
failing_checks.reason: The slippage bound is required only to be non-undefined. destMin "0" or "0.0000001" passes, and sendMax is checked the same way, so a path payment can execute at any rate. The price is not computed from requester fields, but the bound itself is not meaningful.

failing_checks.title: Expiry and fees
failing_checks.reason: Default timeouts are applied: TransactionBuilder.ts:65-67 calls setTimeout(defaultTimeout) when no timebounds are given, and the number form at Stellar.ts:89-92 sets maxTime from now.
